verdict.rationale: Statsig is a SaaS analytics and experimentation platform that ingests customer event data, so a training opt-out or no-training policy is a fair privacy question for it. The evidence pack documents no setting, policy or contractual commitment that prevents customer data from being used to train AI models. The AI-related docs cover experimenting on prompts and models and the MCP servers, which are adjacent features, not a training opt-out.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
